title: Saudi Arabia Launches Airstrikes on Sanaa and Three Yemeni Provinces
detail: Saudi Arabia launched airstrikes targeting Sanaa and three Yemeni provinces, according to Houthi statements. The strikes mark a significant escalation following recent Saudi-UAE military coordination, intensifying the air campaign against Houthi-controlled territory.

title: Houthis Strike Medina Power Station, Threatening Electricity Near Islam's Holy City
detail: The Saudi-led coalition accused Houthi forces of striking the Medina power station, threatening electricity supply near one of Islam's holiest cities. The attack represents a significant escalation targeting critical civilian infrastructure deep inside Saudi Arabia.

title: WFP Reports Record Numbers Going Hungry in Yemen as Conflict Escalates
detail: The World Food Programme reported record numbers of people facing hunger in Yemen as escalating conflict continues to worsen the humanitarian crisis. The UN agency's data adds official weight to an already dire food security picture, with fighting disrupting supply chains and aid access across Houthi-controlled and government-held territories alike.

title: Saudi Arabia Plans 100,000-Troop Ground and Air Offensive to Retake Bab el-Mandeb Strait
detail: Saudi Arabia is planning a major combined ground and air offensive involving up to 100,000 troops to retake the Bab el-Mandeb strait from Houthi forces, according to reports from The Independent, Ynetnews, and Reuters. The operation is aimed at breaking the Houthi stranglehold on Red Sea shipping lanes, which has disrupted global maritime trade since the Houthis seized strategic chokepoints in September 2026.

title: Houthis Claim Saudi Arabia Carried Out 94 Airstrikes on Yemeni Territory
detail: Houthi forces claim Saudi Arabia carried out 94 airstrikes on Yemeni territory as the Saudi air campaign against Houthi positions intensifies. The claimed strike count reflects a major escalation in aerial bombardment coinciding with Saudi preparations for a ground offensive to retake strategic chokepoints seized by the Houthis in September 2026.

title: Houthi Projectile Strikes School in Saudi Arabia, Escalating Cross-Border Attacks on Civilian Infrastructure
detail: A Houthi projectile struck a school in Saudi Arabia, marking a new escalation in cross-border Houthi attacks on Saudi civilian infrastructure. The strike on an educational facility deepens concerns about civilian harm as Houthi forces increasingly target populated areas inside Saudi Arabia amid the broader intensification of the Yemen conflict.
